mintAuthority.summary: ONED native issuance is role-gated and subject to mutable per-minter rate limits. Separate no-code default-admin and beacon-owner addresses can authorize issuance or replace mint logic; the observed 24-hour default-admin transfer delay is not a global mint or upgrade delay.
mintAuthority.headline: Coinbase controls rate-limited minting and immediate upgrades; mutable allowances do not impose an economic supply ceiling.

controls.label: ONED authorized minter
controls.evidence: At Base block 52635892 (2026-10-15T10:45:31Z), hasRole(MINT_ROLE,minter)=true and currentMintLimit(minter)=5000000 ONED. Mint allowance is configurable; this is not an immutable supply ceiling. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody. controls.label: ONED default admin

That delay governs admin transfer, not ordinary minting or a globally timelocked upgrade. Token source exposes role and minter configuration powers. eth_getCode(controller)=0x. A no-code address does not establish single-person or MPC key custody. RPC: https://api-base-mainnet-archive.n.dwellir.com.

review.evidence: Complete Base RoleGranted/RoleRevoked census from creation block 44701636 through 52635892 (2026-10-15T10:45:31Z) returns ten grants and no revocations. Current hasRole checks confirm every grant: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE=0x9446ce5c9e8b47d7e6cb229a42eaae32d4e8aaf9; MINT_ROLE=0x026bbff480a3dfde0f60ec525029c746fbb0f485; MINT_RATE_LIMIT_ROLE=0x6627aae9c802204695dd323d22fdf437867f4f17; BURN_ROLE=0xac1a4d9ad653c507f80adcffe1693924a90f7dd0; BLOCKLIST_ROLE and UNBLOCKLIST_ROLE=0x2c34489fd3b7cc2a5dc4a47b34b117d3f62b6e9e; PAUSE_ROLE=0xe0f6c6c500081b51cefc805bc5fdacfc478c5617; UNPAUSE_ROLE=0xd9105ae607e3f3c89cde50300d7cd2057a986cd5; METADATA_ROLE=0x772f14c70b78fe9a1c821a3e2583cdeb148af2ff and the default admin. Only native issuance and mint-logic replacement powers are represented in controls; burn, blocklist, pause and metadata are not new mint paths. The token beacon slot and beacon getters confirm the existing implementation and owner. All four mint controllers return eth_getCode=0x; key-custody safeguards and beneficial signer independence remain undisclosed. The default admin can grant minters, reset limits and immediately replace the beacon; the beacon owner can replace shared logic. The 86400-second delay governs admin transfer only, and the mutable 5000000 ONED current allowance does not bound aggregate economic issuance. Financial reconciliation and ONED-specific prudential supervision remain unknown; neither wallet matching nor a code audit resolves them.
